newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY BCE FOREX FUTURES TRADE TOUCHES YEAR LOW.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY BCE FOREX FUTURES TRADE TOUCHES YEAR LOW.

text.p: Hungary's currency futures market saw very low turnover on Friday, reflecting traders' hesitancy over the dollar's latest surge, dealers said.
The Budapest Commodity Exchange saw its lowest turnover this year at 666 million forints, spread between the mark, dollar and yen.
The mark was stable for all months, while the yen was down for all maturities. The dollar eased for September, December and March but strengthened for June.
The Budapest Stock Exchange saw 1.35 million forints' worth of turnover, taken up by dollar/mark basket deals for July August and next June.
The most significant price movement was in the July dollar, which rose 3.44 to 188.9 forints.
